proverbes.name: Le Jardin des Proverbes
proverbes.alt: A formal French garden of clipped hedges and gravel paths, painted in ink and gouache. A mayor in a tricolor sash stretches an amazingly long arm right across the hedges to ring the bell of a little house; a stone statue of a bearded sage holds a scroll, with an owl on its head and a snail on its plinth. A lazy man dozes in a hammock, one hair sprouting from his open palm; a cook tips out his empty pot as the very last bean falls; a girl studies a ladybird on a perfect cake through a huge magnifying glass; and a guest in a bowler hat tiptoes away, finger to his lips, from two ladies chatting over tea. A cream pavilion on the left has red, orange, yellow, green and blue doors; one on the right has pink, white, brown and black doors; the little wooden gate at the bottom right leads back to the park.

patience.name: L'allée de la patience
patience.alt: The alley of patience, a starry-and-sunny garden of hedge plots painted in ink and gouache. At midnight a tortoise breaks the finish ribbon to cheers from a girl, a rabbit, a squirrel and a mouse; a fireman calmly sips tea on a bench while a snail strolls by; a bird adds a twig to its nest; and a wise owl watches over an egg. Little builders in hard hats lay bricks round a model Colosseum, and a boy offers a glass of water in front of a great wave rising from a pond. The red door in the brick wall on the left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.

meteo.name: La pelouse de la météo
meteo.alt: The weather lawn, painted in ink and gouache. A frog lifts its umbrella to the sun as a rainbow appears; a boy and girl are struck by a lightning cloud and hearts fly; a duck in a scarf shivers by a frozen pond; and a boy in yellow climbs a rope hanging from a raining cloud. A grinning hen shows a mouthful of teeth among ordinary hens, and a wolf in a monk's habit stands among sheep. The orange door of the round stone pavilion on the left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.

theatre.name: Les chambres de verdure
theatre.alt: Hedge 'rooms' of a green garden theater, painted in ink and gouache. A boy at a desk finishes his test with a slice of cake beside him; a rabbit magician winks in a burst of sparkles; a snail waves a white flag on top of a rock it has climbed; and a big-headed boy sulks with his arms crossed. A singer has a kitten peeking out of her scarf, and at a hat stall a shocked customer reads a price tag drawn with a pair of eyes. The yellow door of the shed on the left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.

potager.name: Le potager
potager.alt: The vegetable garden, painted in ink and gouache. A teacher at a blackboard herds sheep back into class; a girl breaks the finish ribbon tapping her nose; a busybody shakes salt into a gardener's soup; and a judge in a wig points straight at a ginger cat on a stool. Many hands reach into a baker's dough, and a boy knocks down two cans with one stone. The green door of the brick shed on the left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.

roseraie.name: La roseraie
roseraie.alt: The rose garden, painted in ink and gouache. A boy snores in a bed on the grass under a rose pergola while the sun is high; another boy sits on a crescent moon, chin in hand; a girl bounces as she bites a peach; and a grinning fish leaps in a fountain. A girl looks through pink rose-tinted glasses, and a shivering woman with goosebumps stands beside a white hen. The blue door in the stone wall on the left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.

verger.name: Le verger
verger.alt: The orchard, painted in ink and gouache. A boy walks along with his head up in a cloud; a wolf in a napkin sits by a stack of empty plates; a sad man sits beside a giant empty plate; and a gloomy cockroach sits at a café table with a coffee under a little rain cloud. A girl hugs a puppy among cherubs on a cloud, and a man faints into a heap of apples. The pink door of the wooden shed on the left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.

doors.hint: Go back through the pink door to the Jardin des Proverbes

kiosque.name: Le kiosque à musique
kiosque.alt: The bandstand, painted in ink and gouache. A baker carries a plank piled with loaves; an actor freezes with stage fright on the bandstand; a girl waits at a café table with a rabbit on the chair opposite; and a boy shrugs and sticks his tongue out at a cat. A boy stamps on a yelping man's feet, and a puzzled man scratches his head while a tiny gardener digs on top of it with a spade. The white door of the park lodge on the left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.

piquenique.name: Le pique-nique
piquenique.alt: A picnic on the lawn, painted in ink and gouache. Two children each hold half of a pear; a skinny boy faces a towering cake; a girl offers a glowing heart from her hand to an old man; and a man walks round and round a big pot over a campfire. A boy has stepped into a dish of spaghetti, and a storyteller juggles lettuces for a group of children. The brown door of the little cabin on the left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.

champ.name: Le champ du fermier
champ.alt: The farmer's field, painted in ink and gouache. A farmer scratches his head because the plow stands in front of his two oxen; a frog leaps from a rooster to a donkey; and a detective with a magnifying glass watches a smiling worm wriggle out of a stone statue's nose. A gentleman in a tuxedo stands proudly on a tall stack of hatboxes, and a seller holds up a bear-shaped fur coat while a live bear grins right behind him. The black door of the stone outbuilding at the top left leads back to the Jardin des Proverbes.
